title: extensions.valid_time
description: Valid-time settings for a graph with validity declarations. 'default' is the instant a statement or fluent step reads when it names none: 'today' (UTC, the built-in default), 'all' (every version, no filtering) or a fixed YYYY-MM-DD day. The --valid-time-default flag overrides it. The setting is runtime only and never written into a .kgl file.
